item.description: (AP) — U.S. President Donald Trump announced Friday that nine drugmakers have agreed to lower the cost of their prescription drugs in the U.S. Pharmaceutical companies Amgen, Bristol Myers Squibb, Boehringer Ingelheim, Genentech, Gilead Sciences, GSK, Merck, Novartis and Sanofi will now rein in Medicaid drug prices to match what they charged in other developed […]

item.title: Braun: Expect more on property taxes, affordability in 2026
item.description: Gov. Mike Braun is encouraging lawmakers to consider additional changes to property taxes in 2026, while also prioritizing affordability in areas such as health care and utility costs.

item.title: What marijuana rescheduling means for Indiana
item.description: President Trump's executive order to reclassify marijuana as a Schedule III controlled substance could spark discussions about legalization in Indiana, as advocates for cannabis reform believe it could change the conversation in Washington and encourage conservative lawmakers to reconsider their stance on the issue.
